paper.citation: Liu, Y. and Fan, Y. (2023). Biased-sample empirical likelihood weighting for missing data problems: an alternative to inverse probability weighting. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B 85(1), 67–83. DOI: 10.1093/jrsssb/qkac006.
paper.venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B
paper.source_locator: Section 3, Example 1, journal p. 76 (PDF p. 10); choose gamma=2.5, c=1, Model 2; Table 1 on journal p. 77/PDF p. 11.

mechanism.name: MAR response with directly generated propensity score, light-tail Model 2

generation_equations.label: Propensity score coordinate
generation_equations.expression: P=pi(X) generated directly: Pr(P<=u)=u^(gamma-1), u in [0,1], gamma=2.5; equivalently Beta(1.5,1)

generation_equations.label: Full outcome
generation_equations.expression: eta~chi-square(4) independent of P; Y=1-P+c*(eta-4)/sqrt(8), c=1 (Model 2)

generation_equations.label: Observed encoding
generation_equations.expression: Y_observed=Y when D=1 and 0 placeholder when D=0

observed_variables.name: Y_observed
observed_variables.role: outcome when D=1; zero placeholder otherwise; mask using D

assumptions: The fully observed propensity score P=pi(X) is generated directly with CDF u^(gamma-1), 0<=u<=1. No original X is simulated.
MAR: D|P~Bernoulli(P), D=1 means Y observed; D conditionally independent of eta and Y given P.
P>0 almost surely but is not bounded uniformly away from zero.

properties.notes: One fully observed propensity-score coordinate P, generated directly rather than inventing an X. Model 2 has a linear conditional mean in P; P has a nonuniform beta distribution.

estimand.name: theta = E(Y)
estimand.definition: Full-data superpopulation response mean before outcome masking.

truth.expression: Full-data superpopulation response mean before outcome masking.
truth.derivation: P~Beta(gamma-1,1) gives E(P)=(gamma-1)/gamma; centered chi-square noise has mean zero. For gamma=2.5, E(Y)=1/gamma=0.4.

adaptations: One generate call returns one sample rather than all paper Monte Carlo repetitions.
A finite zero placeholder encodes missing Y in the numeric-only interface; mask with the observation indicator.
